description: The file defines a PHP class 'VersionAPI' that extends an abstract REST controller, providing an endpoint to retrieve version information related to the application's setup or migrations.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API class that provides version information for the installer/upgrader process, with functionality to retrieve a list of versions, optionally excluding the latest.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of version keys, optionally excluding the latest version based on request parameters.
